items.title: Distillation update must not corrupt the recurrent teacher's hidden state
items.criterion: Distillation.update no longer resets, restores or saves the teacher's hidden state. Only the student's last hidden state is kept between updates. A test with an RNNModel teacher shows its hidden state is unchanged by update().

items.title: Runner and logger handle deterministic policies without a distribution
items.criterion: OnPolicyRunner.learn reads output_std only when policy.distribution is not None. Logger.log accepts action_std=None and skips the Policy/mean_std entry in that case. A deterministic distillation student trains without AttributeError.

items.title: Fix off-by-one learning iteration counter on resume
items.criterion: After each iteration, current_learning_iteration becomes it + 1, so a resumed or repeated learn() starts at the next iteration. It must not repeat an iteration or overwrite model_{it}.pt. Tests are updated to match.

items.title: Deduplicate shared actor/critic CNN parameters in the PPO optimizer
items.criterion: The PPO optimizer is built from a parameter list deduplicated by identity, so shared CNN encoder parameters appear once and get a single Adam step. A test with shared cnns checks for no duplicate parameters.

items.title: Recurrent PPO surrogate loss keeps the environment dimension
items.criterion: The ratio and surrogate terms use squeeze(-1) on old_actions_log_prob and advantages instead of a bare torch.squeeze. Shapes then pair per transition for recurrent and size-1 batches. A regression test compares against a per-transition objective.

items.title: Feed-forward mini-batch generator yields every sample per epoch
items.criterion: mini_batch_generator permutes the full batch_size and splits it into balanced chunks (i*B//n to (i+1)*B//n). No remainder samples are dropped. A test with a non-divisible batch size checks full coverage.

items.title: Recurrent mini-batch generator covers all environments
items.criterion: recurrent_mini_batch_generator uses balanced environment ranges, so trailing envs are not dropped when num_envs is not divisible by num_mini_batches. A test covers the non-divisible case.

items.title: Reject out-of-range num_mini_batches in storage generators
items.criterion: Both generators raise ValueError when num_mini_batches < 1 or exceeds the batch size (feed-forward) or num_envs (recurrent). Empty mini-batches can no longer be produced.

items.title: Reshuffle feed-forward mini-batch indices every epoch
items.criterion: A new torch.randperm is drawn inside the epoch loop of mini_batch_generator while keeping full coverage. A test shows that mini-batch composition differs between epochs.

items.title: Persist RND update_counter in PPO checkpoints
items.criterion: PPO.save stores the RND update_counter and PPO.load restores it, defaulting to 0 for legacy checkpoints, so the weight schedule resumes where it stopped. Tests cover resume and legacy load.

items.title: Persist discounted reward average in normalization state_dict
items.criterion: _DiscountedAverage.avg is a registered buffer or is otherwise included in the state_dict and moved by .to(). A save/load round trip preserves it.

items.title: Discounted variation normalization works for non-scalar shapes
items.criterion: EmpiricalDiscountedVariationNormalization.forward removes the tensor-valued `if std > 0` and divides elementwise using eps or torch.where. A multi-element shape no longer raises, and a test covers it.

items.title: check_nan also detects infinite values
items.criterion: check_nan uses torch.isfinite on obs, rewards and dones and raises ValueError naming NaN, Inf or both. Docs and comments are updated, and tests cover NaN, +Inf and -Inf.

items.title: Advantage normalization does not produce NaN for a single sample
items.criterion: Global and per-mini-batch advantage normalization is skipped or uses population std when there is only one element, so a singleton advantage stays finite and keeps its value. Tests cover both modes.

items.title: Close and flush all logging writers including TensorBoard
items.criterion: Logger.stop_logging_writer closes a plain SummaryWriter as well as LogWriter subclasses. W&B and Neptune writers also close their inherited TensorBoard writer, and duplicate file uploads are avoided.

items.title: Stop the logging writer even when training raises
items.criterion: OnPolicyRunner.learn wraps the training loop in try/finally (or equivalent), so the writer is stopped or closed on exceptions. A runner test verifies this.

items.title: Discounted reward history independent of caller's tensor
items.criterion: _DiscountedAverage.update clones the first reward instead of aliasing it, so in-place edits of the returned value do not change avg. A test covers in-place scaling.

items.title: Skip obs-normalizer updates for image-only CNN models
items.criterion: MLPModel.update_normalization does nothing when obs_groups is empty, as for CNN models with only 2D inputs, instead of concatenating an empty list.

items.title: RND loss excludes padded steps for recurrent policies
items.criterion: When batch.masks is not None, observations are unpadded (e.g. obs[masks] or unpad_trajectories) before rnd.compute_loss, so the predictor never trains on padding zeros.

items.title: Make RNN reset and selective detach autograd-safe
items.criterion: RNN.reset(dones) and detach_hidden_state(dones) replace in-place slice edits with functional masking (torch.where or a mask multiply) for GRU and both LSTM states. A backward pass with dones inside an accumulation window succeeds in a test.

items.title: W&B/Neptune store_config handles plain dict env configs
items.criterion: store_config uses env_cfg directly when it is a dict, asdict only for dataclasses, and to_dict when available, with a final fallback. Each form is tested.

items.title: resolve_callable does not mask transitive import errors
items.criterion: In the dotted branch, a ModuleNotFoundError is re-raised unless e.name is the module path being probed. A test uses a module whose own import of a dependency fails.

items.title: Validate symmetry augmentation batch sizes
items.criterion: augment_batch computes num_aug with divmod and raises ValueError on a remainder, mismatched obs/action counts, or None outputs, instead of truncating silently.

items.title: Reject unknown RNN types instead of defaulting to LSTM
items.criterion: RNN.__init__ accepts only 'gru' and 'lstm' (case-insensitive) and raises ValueError otherwise. A constructor test covers this.

items.title: Validate distribution init_std, std_range and Beta action_range
items.criterion: The Gaussian distributions raise ValueError for init_std <= 0 or std_range min >= max. BetaDistribution raises for action_range[1] <= action_range[0]. Failure tests are added.

items.title: Stop globally disabling torch distribution argument validation
items.criterion: The Normal/Beta set_default_validate_args(False) calls are removed. Internal distributions are constructed with validate_args=False locally, so global PyTorch defaults are unchanged.

items.title: Include action-range Jacobian in Beta entropy
items.criterion: BetaDistribution.entropy adds log(range_scale) per action dimension before summing, consistent with log_prob. Tests compare ranges (0,1) and (-1,1).

items.title: Clip PPO gradients over one deduplicated parameter set
items.criterion: Gradient clipping runs once over the unique union of actor and critic parameters, not separately per module. Shared params are clipped once and the global norm is bounded.

items.title: resolve_rnd_config works for envs without unwrapped.step_dt
items.criterion: resolve_rnd_config uses getattr fallbacks for unwrapped and step_dt, with a documented fallback or warning, so a plain VecEnv with RND does not raise AttributeError.

items.title: Validate RND weight_schedule configuration eagerly
items.criterion: RandomNetworkDistillation.__init__ checks that mode is in {constant, step, linear} and that required keys exist per mode, with final_step > initial_step for linear. It raises descriptive ValueErrors.

items.title: Default checkpoint map_location to runner device
items.criterion: OnPolicyRunner.load uses self.device when map_location is not given, so GPU checkpoints load on CPU runners.

items.title: Support tensor max_episode_length in random episode init
items.criterion: With init_at_random_ep_len=True, learn() draws random lengths using per-env bounds when max_episode_length is a multi-element tensor, instead of calling int().

items.title: JIT export wrappers are device-consistent
items.criterion: The GRU and LSTM (and other) _Torch* export wrappers no longer leave submodules on different devices: either all are moved to CPU or none are. A device-consistency test is added.

items.title: Pass Python scalars to writer.add_scalar for episode extras
items.criterion: Logger.log converts reduced episode-extra values with .item() before passing them to add_scalar.

items.title: Logger does not mutate env extras dicts
items.criterion: Logger.log builds local tensors (e.g. torch.as_tensor(...).reshape(-1)) instead of writing converted values back into ep_info.

items.title: Neptune save_file derives names portably
items.criterion: save_file derives the name with pathlib.Path(path).stem or os.path.splitext, so Windows paths and multi-dot filenames work.

items.title: Validate PPO hyperparameters at construction
items.criterion: PPO.__init__ raises ValueError when schedule is not in {adaptive, fixed}, epochs or mini-batches are non-positive, clip_param <= 0, or gamma or lam is outside [0,1].

items.title: MLP rejects empty or invalid hidden_dims clearly
items.criterion: MLP.__init__ raises a clear ValueError for an empty hidden_dims or non-positive dims other than -1, or supports a single linear layer, instead of raising IndexError.

items.title: Validate CNN per-layer parameter list lengths
items.criterion: CNN.__init__ checks that kernel_size, stride, dilation, norm and max_pool sequences have length equal to len(output_channels), and raises ValueError otherwise.

items.title: Validate CNN padding mode names
items.criterion: CNN.__init__ raises ValueError for padding values outside none/zeros/reflect/replicate/circular instead of silently using no padding.

items.title: EmpiricalNormalization rejects empty or mis-shaped batches
items.criterion: update() returns early or raises on an empty batch, and validates that trailing dims match the configured shape, so NaN moments and broadcast corruption cannot occur.

items.title: Validate RolloutStorage training_type and sizes
items.criterion: RolloutStorage.__init__ raises ValueError when training_type is not 'rl' or 'distillation' or when env/transition counts are non-positive.

items.title: Hoist loop-invariant work out of recurrent generator loops
items.criterion: dones squeeze, last_was_done, its permute and per-env trajectory offsets are computed once before the epoch and mini-batch loops, not per mini-batch.

items.title: Reset discounted RND reward accumulator at episode ends
items.criterion: Done masks are passed into intrinsic reward normalization, or a reset method is exposed, and the accumulator is zeroed for done envs. A test with known short episodes is added.

items.title: Distribution output properties fail clearly when unavailable
items.criterion: output_mean, output_std, output_entropy and output_distribution_params raise a clear error or return None when there is no distribution, or when it has not yet been populated, instead of raising a NoneType AttributeError.

items.title: RNNModel keeps the time dimension when T == 1 in batch mode
items.criterion: The RNN output is squeezed only in rollout mode (masks is None). Batch mode with num_steps_per_env == 1 keeps shape [1, N, H].

items.title: split_and_pad_trajectories preserves input dtype
items.criterion: The padding zeros tensor uses the input tensor's dtype, so uint8 observations pad correctly. A test with a uint8 tensor is added.

items.title: JIT export puts the model in eval mode
items.criterion: export_policy_to_jit calls .eval() on the as_jit() copy before torch.jit.script.

items.title: PPO.load tolerates checkpoints lacking RND state
items.criterion: RND state and optimizer are loaded only if their keys exist in the checkpoint. Otherwise a warning is emitted instead of a KeyError.

items.title: Runner load tolerates checkpoints without infos
items.criterion: OnPolicyRunner.load returns loaded_dict.get('infos') rather than indexing the key directly.

items.title: Logger ETA correct across multiple learn() calls
items.criterion: The ETA uses elapsed time from the current learn() call only, not the logger's lifetime total time.

items.title: Symmetry compute_loss does not overwrite batch.observations
items.criterion: When use_data_augmentation is False, augmented observations are stored in a local variable instead of replacing batch.observations.

items.title: Symmetry logging-only mode runs without autograd
items.criterion: When use_mirror_loss is False, the mirrored forward pass and loss run under torch.no_grad().

items.title: Distillation rejects unknown config keys
items.criterion: Distillation.__init__ pops known no-op keys (rnd_cfg, symmetry_cfg) explicitly and warns or raises for any remaining kwargs.

items.title: Distillation steps on the final partial gradient accumulation
items.criterion: A remainder accumulation that does not fill gradient_length gets a final backward and optimizer step instead of being discarded. Tests are updated.

items.title: Normalize distillation accumulated loss by accumulation length
items.criterion: The accumulated loss is divided by the actual number of summed timesteps, including the partial group, so gradient scale does not grow with gradient_length.

items.title: Validate distillation optimization parameters
items.criterion: Distillation.__init__ raises ValueError for non-positive gradient_length, epochs, learning rate, bucket size, or max_grad_norm.

items.title: Freeze distillation teacher parameters
items.criterion: Teacher parameters are set to requires_grad=False while the teacher stays in eval mode. Teacher forward passes and checkpoint loading still work.

items.title: Freeze RND target network parameters
items.criterion: All RND target parameters have requires_grad_(False), and a test checks that the target receives no gradients.

items.title: Initialize RND weight attribute in constructor
items.criterion: RandomNetworkDistillation.__init__ sets self.weight, so it is accessible before get_intrinsic_reward is called.

items.title: Heteroscedastic scalar std keeps gradients below the floor
items.criterion: For std_type='scalar', a softplus (plus floor) is applied before clamping, and init uses the inverse-softplus of init_std as the bias.

items.title: Heteroscedastic log-std init exactly matches init_std
items.criterion: init_mlp_weights uses log(init_std) without adding 1e-7, so the initial std equals init_std, consistent with GaussianDistribution.

items.title: Distribution init_mlp_weights locates the last Linear layer dynamically
items.criterion: Heteroscedastic and Beta init_mlp_weights find the final nn.Linear instead of hardcoding mlp[-2], so they work when last_activation is set.

items.title: Create a fresh activation module per layer in MLP and CNN
items.criterion: MLP and CNN instantiate a new activation module for each layer instead of reusing one instance.

items.title: CNNModel JIT/ONNX export works without 1D observations
items.criterion: _TorchCNNModel and _OnnxCNNModel handle obs_dim == 0 by skipping 1D normalization and concatenation. A test exports a vision-only policy.

items.title: Correct CNN same-padding for odd sizes and strides
items.criterion: _compute_padding never returns negative padding and applies asymmetric padding where needed to reach ceil(input/stride). A test checks odd rectangular inputs.

items.title: Timeout bootstrapping robust to time_outs shape
items.criterion: process_env_step reshapes time_outs with view(-1) and squeezes values with squeeze(-1), so the bootstrap term matches the rewards shape regardless of input shape.

items.title: learn() with zero iterations does not overwrite a checkpoint
items.criterion: When num_learning_iterations <= 0, learn() returns early or skips the post-loop save.

items.title: Guard FPS computation against zero elapsed time
items.criterion: Logger.log guards the collect_time + learn_time denominator against zero.

items.title: resolve_obs_groups rejects string group values
items.criterion: A str (or other non-list) value in obs_groups raises a clear error or is wrapped in a list, instead of being iterated per character.

items.title: resolve_obs_groups does not mutate the caller's dict
items.criterion: resolve_obs_groups copies its input before filling defaults, leaving the caller's dict unchanged.

items.title: Rollout storage preserves distribution-param dtype
items.criterion: Lazily allocated distribution_params buffers use the incoming tensor's dtype and device. A test with a non-default dtype is added.

items.title: Validate transitions and refuse generating from incomplete rollouts
items.criterion: add_transition validates required fields for the training mode. Generators raise on, or limit themselves to, partially filled storage (step < capacity).

items.title: Validate reduce_gradients_in_buckets arguments
items.criterion: Non-positive bucket size or world size raises ValueError before any processing.

items.title: CNN.init_weights handles Conv2d without bias
items.criterion: Bias is zero-initialized only if module.bias is not None.

items.title: MLP.init_weights indexes scales per Linear layer
items.criterion: A separate counter for Linear layers selects per-layer scales, instead of the Sequential index.

items.title: Remove redundant MLP/CNN forward overrides and dead init_weights
items.criterion: The forward overrides identical to nn.Sequential.forward are deleted. Unused init_weights is either removed or wired to a config option with a test.

items.title: Keep symmetry-augmented batch fields consistently sized
items.criterion: augment_batch repeats or documents old_distribution_params consistently with the other repeated batch fields.

items.title: Avoid rescanning the log directory for videos every iteration
items.criterion: Logger.log scans only a dedicated videos subdirectory, or throttles the scan, instead of running rglob over the whole log dir each iteration.

items.title: Adaptive-LR and loss tests exercise real PPO.update
items.criterion: The tests call ppo.update() with schedule='adaptive' and a monkeypatched KL, then assert on ppo.learning_rate and the optimizer lr, instead of re-implementing the logic in the test.

items.title: Strengthen zero-std discounted normalization test
items.criterion: test_zero_std_returns_raw_reward asserts that the output equals the input reward under fresh statistics, and a multi-element shape test is added.

items.title: Add tests for DistillationRunner, Logger and resolve_obs_groups
items.criterion: New tests cover the DistillationRunner teacher-loaded guard and learn loop, Logger aggregation, and resolve_obs_groups defaults and errors.

items.title: Fix BetaDistribution init docstring or make init near-uniform
items.criterion: Either both alpha and beta halves of the last layer are initialized for a near-uniform distribution, or the docstring is corrected.

items.title: Symmetry keys documented as optional with their defaults
items.criterion: configuration.rst no longer marks use_data_augmentation, use_mirror_loss and mirror_loss_coeff as required, and lists their defaults.

items.title: Resolve misleading 'crelu' activation mapping to CELU
items.criterion: The 'crelu' activation name is renamed or remapped correctly, or its mapping to CELU is documented explicitly.

items.title: Document VecEnv observation buffer lifetime requirement
items.criterion: VecEnv get_observations and step docstrings state that returned observation tensors must not be modified in place until process_env_step has copied them into storage.

items.title: Remove unused verbose argument from ONNX export wrappers
items.criterion: as_onnx and the _Onnx*Model constructors for the MLP, CNN and RNN models drop the unused verbose parameter, and callers are updated.

items.title: CI and docs support the extras branch
items.criterion: The lint, test and docs workflows run on the extras branch. The docs build publishes main and extras sites. Contribution docs explain targeting main for fixes and extras for features.
